lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly visible grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots (blobs) organized into approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with increasing spatial density towards the dorsal midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible across the mid-flank, intersecting with the horizontal blob rows to create a rectilinear pattern of nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, each exhibiting a clear luminance gradient with specular highlights on the upper boundary and soft shadows below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, fusiform silhouettes consistent with commensal fish (remoras) located beneath the pectoral fin and along the ventral profile.
